convert_crowdhuman_to_coco: run the CrowdHuman to COCO format converter for train and validation datasets
load_odgt_annotations: create a function that loads CrowdHuman ODGT annotation files and returns parsed JSON data
convert_train_set: run the CrowdHuman to COCO converter on the training dataset with bounding box annotations
convert_val_set: run the CrowdHuman to COCO converter on the validation dataset with pedestrian annotations
parse_converter_args: create an argparse parser that accepts input and output directory arguments for CrowdHuman conversion
